title: 船外機付きリジッドインフレータブル救助艇外形
description: 港湾や救助艇置場の背景に置く、小型の無銘柄リジッドインフレータブル艇。硬いチャインを持つ開放船殻、連続した丸いU字カラーと擦れ止め・取付け済みロープ、低い床、支持された後部ベンチ、中央コンソールと舵輪、トランサムの固定具、独自形状の船外機外装・下部脚・スケグ・三枚の固定プロペラを造形。一式1点で、救助・浮力・航行・安全認証は一切主張しません。 最下点をY=0とする水平中央原点です。水面の高さ・喫水位置は配置側で選んでください。水・人物・物理挙動・操縦・浮力・流体力学・救助機能は含まず、静的外形のみです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.567 × 1.395 × 4.901 m、20,552三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A small unbranded rigid-inflatable craft exterior for harbour and rescue-station backgrounds. The hard-chine open hull has a continuous round U collar, abrasion strip and attached grab ropes, low sole, supported aft bench, center console and steering wheel. A clamped transom mount carries an original outboard cowling, lower leg, skeg and three fixed propeller blades. One assembly; no rescue, flotation, navigation or safety certification is claimed. The horizontally centered origin places the lowest geometry point at Y=0; choose the waterline and immersion height in your own scene. No water, people, physics, driving, flotation, hydrodynamics or rescue functionality is included: this is a static exterior assembly. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.567 × 1.395 × 4.901 m; 20,552 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
